dateLabel: 3rd century BCE (earliest securely dated: Ashoka edicts, 250-232 BCE)
title: Brahmi script
summary: Brahmi appeared as a fully developed script in the 3rd century BCE; it is an abugida, adding vowel marks to consonant signs.
why: Ancestor of the Brahmic scripts used across South and Southeast Asia today.

notes.problem: Vowel-mark description wrong (abugida); pre-Mauryan sherds are controversial, so the label should name the secure anchor.
